review_candidates.description: E N D P O I N T S P E C I A L I S T _____________________________________________ Full-time | Permanent | Goteborg/Malmo A B O U T X E N I T Xenit is a growth company which specializes in Cloud and Modern Work. Our committed employees inspire, challenge and encourage each other, while providing extensive value for our customers. Xenit is Microsoft's Partner of the Year Sweden for 2024; illustrating our commitment to technical development, being on the cutting edge of tech, and our close partnership with Microsoft. W H A T W E N E E D 🙏🏻 We're looking for talented consultants to join our Endpoint Team in Modern Work. You will be a key player in driving the digital transformation for our clients, responsible for both technical implementation and strategic consultation within Configuration Manager and Intune . Examples Of Potential Tasks/responsibilities Designing and implementing client management solutions, focused on Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager, optimizing our customers’ IT environments. Contributing to and further developing our client management services, continuously enhancing and streamlining clients' endpoint management. Supporting the sales team in pre-sales activities Acting as a technical advisor; creating proposals, meeting with clients, and ensuring the best solution for each customer. Leading projects from start to finish, ensuring seamless integration of solutions in both cloud and hybrid environments. Utilizing PowerShell scripting and automation to improve workflows and maintain secure, robust systems. C O U L D Y O U B E A M A T C H ? We Believe Our Specialist Has 3–5 years of experience working as a consultant within Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager. Strong technical knowledge of the Microsoft 365 platform, with experience managing endpoints such as laptops, iPhones, and Android devices. Proficiency in PowerShell scripting Experience with cloud and hybrid solutions; knowledge from an on-premise perspective, as well as cloud based. The ability to act as a strategic advisor, offering customized solutions to meet clients’ unique needs It Is a Bonus If You Have Relevant certifications Experience with macOS 🤩 We Also Believe That You Are a Person Who Has a "senior presence" - happy to offer advice and collaborate with others Is passionate about tech, and particularly endpoint management (of course). Speaks fluent Swedish and English Above all, displays kindness in everything they do 💞 W H Y C H O O S E X E N I T ? Benefits 🎁 Xenit boasts a large benefits package, read full list here . Activities ⛹🏻 Each quarter, we host Xenit Inspire where employees are able to share specialist knowledge, information about cool projects, and take part in tasks centered around innovation - workshops and hackathons. We also offer annual conferences, team building, after works, and "Bring a Buddy" lunches at the office. In 2024 and 2025 Xenit was recognised as a "Career Company" . This prestigious acknowledgement underscores our commitment to fostering a workplace culture that values inclusivity, well-being, and growth. "Xenit is an outstanding employer where corporate culture and well-being are at the center. Here, the employees are part of a warm and inclusive community where their well-being and well-being are prioritized. By offering an environment where collaboration, creativity and innovation are encouraged, employees can thrive and develop while contributing to the company's success." Read more about Karriar Företagen here .
